Mechanics

[edit | edit source]

The Raffle of the Century has 3 tiers of raffles known as the Speed Raffle, Daily Raffle and The Big One. The Speed Raffle rolls every 2 hours, the Daily Raffle every 24 hours, and The Big One at the end of the event.

In order to participate in the Raffle of the Century, the player must speak to Rezzus in the  Village to be assigned to one of the following teams: BLUE, YELLOW, GREEN, RED or PINK. Upon joining a team, the player gains 3 Raffle Tickets and a corresponding team Emblem is applied for the remainder of the event and cannot be removed.

After a player is assigned to a team, they can then either speak to the Incredible Raffle Box, open the Incredible Raffle Box in the SkyBlock Menu, or use /century or /centuryrafflebox to see all the rewards, tasks, and current raffles.

Earning Tickets

[edit | edit source]

To enter a raffle, the player must earn Raffle Tickets. Raffle Tickets can be earned through various methods.

Being Online

[edit | edit source]

The player earns 1 Raffle Ticket for every 15 minutes of being online, totaling 96 Raffle Tickets per day.

[edit | edit source]

Miscellaneous

[edit | edit source]

During the event, players can talk to Simon to receive a  Random Century Cake.

Once the Raffle of the Century ends, each player can claim a  Cake Slice of the Century as a Memento. Only  1 Cake Slice of the Century can be claimed per account.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • According to Simon, the Year 500 Raffle was supplied heavily by Sirius.
  • The button for the Incredible Raffle Box in the Skyblock Menu does not appear when on a Ⓑ Bingo Profile. Instead it will be an empty slot, the slot is not even filled with a blank glass pane.
  • The "Eat a slice of Century Cake" raffle task can be completed in multiple ways, unlike other tasks.
    • By either eating a Century Cake Slice fed to you by another player.
    • By right clicking on a Century Cake on a private island.
